_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/feedback/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe.
_note_strokes: Both spinner colours are sampled in the MIDDLE of a 6px-wide FILLED band, not on a stroke. Measured, not assumed: the radio in probes/widgets/display-probe-sibling `probes/widgets/form` is lineStyle(2) on a radius-7 circle, and its byte-exact frame shows a ONE-pixel ring -- a stroked circle does not rasterize to its declared width, so a fill is the only pass through which a widget's colour can be pinned. See SpinnerWidget's header.

_derivation.root: column, align-items flex-start, padding 20, gap 10, size [320,260]. Root rect (0,0,320,260); content starts at (20,20), content width 280.
_derivation.r1: First child of the column: explicit width 210, height 40 -> (20,20,210,40). It is a ROW with gap 10 and align-items flex-start, so its children keep their own heights.
_derivation.sp: spinner size [40,40] -> first in the row at (20,20,40,40). Centre (40,40). diameter 40 => the band's OUTER radius is 20, thickness 6 => the inner radius is 14, so the band spans radius 14..20 and its middle is radius 17.
_derivation.sk_t: skeleton variant text, explicit width 160, auto height. 3 lines, barHeight 8, gap 6 => h = 3*8 + 2*6 = 36. Row places it after the 40px spinner plus the 10px gap: x = 20 + 40 + 10 = 70 -> (70,20,160,36). Bars at local y 0..8, 14..22, 28..36 => absolute y 20..28, 34..42, 48..56. The LAST bar (and only the last, since lines > 1) is 160 * 0.6 = 96 wide, so it spans x 70..166.
_derivation.sk_c: skeleton variant circle, size [40,40]. Second child of the column: y = 20 + 40 + 10 = 70 -> (20,70,40,40). Centre (40,90), radius 20.
_derivation.sk_r: skeleton variant rect, size [200,80]. Third child: y = 70 + 40 + 10 = 120 -> (20,120,200,80).
_derivation.tp: tooltip size [120,30]. Fourth child: y = 120 + 80 + 10 = 210 -> (20,210,120,30). Column content ends at 210+30 = 240, plus the 20px padding = 260 = the root height.

points.spinner_arc: spin false, phase 0 => the arc starts at 12 o'clock and sweeps 3/8 of a turn clockwise (-90..+45 degrees), so 0 degrees is in the MIDDLE of the sweep, not on a square-cut end. At 0 degrees the band's middle radius 17 sits at x = 40 + 17 = 57. The pixel there (column 57 spans x 57..58, centre 57.5) is radius 17.5 from the centre, i.e. 3.5px inside both edges of the 14..20 band. Tone 'info' = #2563EB.
points.spinner_track: The full-circle track is #E5E7EB. 9 o'clock is NOT inside the -90..+45 arc, so sample the same middle radius at x = 40 - 17 = 23 (pixel centre 23.5 => radius 16.5, also well inside 14..20).
points.spinner_hollow: The ring is a band, not a disc: the centre (40,40) is radius 0, which is 14px inside the band's inner edge, so it shows the root background #FFFFFF.
points.skeleton_bar: bar 1 covers y 20..28 and x 70..230; sample its middle (80,24) = #E5E7EB.
points.skeleton_gap: Between bar 1 (ends y 28) and bar 2 (starts y 34): (80,31) shows the root background #FFFFFF, because the skeleton node itself has no background.
points.skeleton_last_bar: bar 3 covers y 48..56; (80,52) is inside it = #E5E7EB.
points.skeleton_last_bar_cut: bar 3 is only 96 wide (x 70..166), so (170,52) is past its end and shows #FFFFFF. 4px of margin from the cut.
points.skeleton_circle_corner: (23,73) is inside the node's rect but outside the radius-20 circle (distance from (40,90) = sqrt(17^2+17^2) = 24.0), so it shows #FFFFFF.
points.tooltip_arrow: arrow 'up' => the bubble starts 6px down and the triangle sits above it, tip at the node's top edge. At y = 213 (halfway between tip y=210 and base y=216) the triangle spans x 80 +/- 3, so (80,213) is inside it = the bubble tone #1F2937.
points.tooltip_bubble: The bubble covers y 216..240 and x 20..140. The label is centred (around x 60..100), so (120,237) is inside the solid bottom-right of the bubble, 3px above its bottom edge and 16px right of the text = #1F2937.

_derivation.behaviour: Steady-state layout solves do not increase after the settle capture; the frozen spinner uses an explicit phase so the frame is byte-deterministic; after the bitmap is written the live description is flipped to spin:true and the probe asserts the spin loop repaints (paintPasses grows) WITHOUT re-solving (layoutSolves flat).
